manifest.name: dsh-client-ui-skin-real-madrid
manifest.description: Real Madrid dual-mode skin for DeepSeek Harness: Bernabéu night stadium for dark, white-kit pinstripes with crest and 1902 layers for light. Unofficial fan work.
manifest.author: alexfengrui <alexfengrui@users.noreply.github.com>

bundle.text:
# Real Madrid skin bundle patch: register the client skin plugin row.
# Install with: dsh plugin --profile web add <this-package-path>
# Remove by uninstalling the package (the row goes away on next boot).
- insert:
    - id: ui-skin-real-madrid
      name: 'dsh-client-ui-skin-real-madrid'

readme.text: <div align="center">

**Real Madrid 双模式皮肤 · DeepSeek Harness** [English](README.en.md) | 简体中文 > ⚠️ **非官方球迷作品** / Unofficial fan work. > 与 Real Madrid C.F.、Adidas、DeepSeek 均无任何关联；队徽等商标归各自权利人所有，**仅限个人非商用学习使用**。详见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

双模式跟随 DeepSeek Harness 的外观设置（Light / Dark / 跟随系统）实时切换：

| 模式 | 设计语言 | 背景 |
|---|---|---|
| 🌙 **Dark** | AWAY 25/26 客场语言：深蓝 + 浅黄点缀 | 伯纳乌夜场全景（看台、泛光灯、草坪） |
| ☀️ **Light** | HOME 25/26 主场语言：暖白 + 金滚边 + 黑三道纹 | 暖白暗纹提花 + 顶部金晕 |

**背景层装饰**（全部位于内容之后，零遮挡）：

- 金边斜体 **"1902" 背号大水印**（右下）
- 全彩**皇马队徽**（右下角）
- **REAL MADRID** 字标 + **HALA MADRID · 1902** 铭文（左下）

**界面元素**：

- 顶部金-蓝-金**发丝线**
- 右上角**黑色三道纹**（主场球衣袖口元素）+ 世俱杯风格**金章**
- 侧栏**金色缝线**、输入卡**金色滚边 + 皇家光晕**
- 双向**交叉提花织纹**（金调 65° + 深调 115°）
- 完整 `--dsw-alias-*` token 覆盖（52 项，`!important` 级）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/alexfengrui/dsh-client-ui-skin-real-madrid
```

然后重启 Harness：`launchctl kickstart -k gui/$UID/com.alexfeng.deepseek-harness`（或你的启动方式），刷新页面生效。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-client-ui-skin-real-madrid
```

重启后还原原版外观。

- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.6` 及以上（web profile）
- 无其他依赖：所有素材以 data URI 内嵌，单文件分发

插件注册一个 web client 模块，向应用框架层（`#root > div > div`）注入多层背景与 token 覆盖：

- 装饰（1902 / 队徽 / 字标）以 **CSS 多层背景**实现——永远位于一切内容之后，不遮挡输入框与文字
- 52 项 `--dsw-alias-*` / `--dsw-specific-*` token 以 `!important` 覆盖（压过 ThemePresenter 的内联写入）
- 亮暗两套 token 分别对应客场/主场球衣配色语言

**Real Madrid dual-mode skin · DeepSeek Harness** English | [简体中文](README.md) > ⚠️ **Unofficial fan work.** > Not affiliated with or endorsed by Real Madrid C.F., Adidas, or DeepSeek. The club crest is a trademark of Real Madrid C.F., included for **personal non-commercial use only**. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

Follows the DeepSeek Harness appearance setting (Light / Dark / System) and switches in real time:

| Mode | Design language | Background |
|---|---|---|
| 🌙 **Dark** | AWAY 25/26 kit language: navy + pale gold accents | Bernabéu match-night panorama (stands, floodlights, pitch) |
| ☀️ **Light** | HOME 25/26 kit language: warm white + gold trim + black stripes | Warm-white jacquard pinstripes + gold crown glow |

**Background-layer decorations** (always behind content, zero occlusion):

- Gold-outlined italic **"1902" jersey-number watermark** (bottom right)
- Full-color **Real Madrid crest** (bottom right corner)
- **REAL MADRID** wordmark + **HALA MADRID · 1902** caption (bottom left)

**Interface elements**:

- Gold-navy-gold **hairline** across the top
- **Three black stripes** (home-kit sleeve motif) + Club-World-Cup-style **gold badge**, top right
- Sidebar **gold seam**, composer card **gold trim + royal glow**
- Dual-direction **jacquard weave** texture (gold 65° + ink 115°)
- Full `--dsw-alias-*` token override (52 declarations, `!important` grade)

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/alexfengrui/dsh-client-ui-skin-real-madrid
```

Then restart Harness (`launchctl kickstart -k gui/$UID/com.alexfeng.deepseek-harness` or your own launch method) and refresh the page.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-client-ui-skin-real-madrid
```

Restart to restore the stock appearance.

- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.6`+ (web profile)
- No other dependencies: all assets are embedded as data URIs — single-file distribution

The plugin registers one web client module that injects multi-layer backgrounds and token overrides into the app frame layer (`#root > div > div`):

- Decorations (1902 / crest / wordmark) are implemented as **CSS multiple background layers** — always behind all content, never blocking inputs or text
- 52 `--dsw-alias-*` / `--dsw-specific-*` tokens are overridden with `!important` (outranks ThemePresenter's inline writes)
- The dark/light token sets mirror the away/home kit color languages
